Name: Kemuel, Son of Shiphtan
Summary: Kemuel, Son of Shiphtan was the prince of Ephraim appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Kemuel was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
